prompt:
Assess this synthetic repository proposal as written. Call architecture_answer exactly once, then stop. Use proceed if it is acceptable as written, revise if a known problem requires a different proposal, or ask-owner if permission or necessary authority/history is unresolved. Explain your reasoning; do not actually modify anything. All relevant synthetic facts are provided below. No repository access is necessary.

Facts:
New project with no ADRs; owner approved adoption.

Proposal:
Write queue ADR-001 and storage ADR-002 now, plus the complete architecture describing both. Later review them and create separate one-ADR commits.

answers.explanation: The proposal violates the required sequential bootstrap: writing both ADRs and the complete architecture now cannot be repaired by later review and separate commits. First write only ADR-001 and its substantive, self-contained architecture update covering only decisions introduced so far; obtain appropriate verification and independent semantic review, then commit that pair. Only afterward begin ADR-002 with its cumulative architecture update, verification, independent review, and separate commit. Owner approval of adoption is established, so no additional authority decision is needed.
